structure.guhs.snackbar.tooltip: The Fry Cone: order snacks and learn frying recipes
item.guhs.snackbarkompas.lore: Points to the nearest Guhsnackbar in the Guhmension. Sold by the vads tamer.
gui.guhs.snackbar.no_build: Njeg! Hands off the Fry Cone: no breaking or building here. Order a nice snack instead!
gui.guhs.snackbar.guh.hallo: NJEG! Welcome to the Fry Cone! What will it be, little chonk? Everything fresh from the fat!
gui.guhs.snackbar.guh.uitleg: Pay me in Cheese Nibbles and you know the recipe forever. After that you just fry it at home in your own frying pan, you never have to come back. But do come by, chonk!
gui.guhs.snackbar.guh.recepten: Which recipe shall I teach you? You pay in Cheese Nibbles.
gui.guhs.snackbar.guh.alles: You know them all, wahoog! I have nothing left to teach you. You should be behind this counter!
gui.guhs.snackbar.guh.te_duur: Njeg, that recipe costs %s Cheese Nibbles and you don't have them on you. Come back later!
gui.guhs.snackbar.guh.geleerd: You now know the recipe for %s! Fry it at home in your pan.
